facts.label: Passado simples e how many
facts.sub: Conte o passeio no passado: I took a lot of pictures. Pergunte How many pictures did you take? e responda com um número.

facts.label: Passado
facts.sub: Para contar o passeio, use o passado simples: I walked, I took, I saw. Take vira took e see vira saw. Esses verbos são irregulares e muito usados.

facts.label: Quantos
facts.sub: Para perguntar uma quantidade, use How many + plural: How many pictures did you take? Responda com um número: I took about two hundred. About quer dizer mais ou menos.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Took is the past of take.
How many is for countable things.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Took is the past of take. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I taked pictures”. → Falso (We say took.)
How many is for countable things. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A park path · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday morning on a path in Ottawa. The leaves are red and yellow. Sara sits on a bench with a camera. Her friend Paul walks along the path. He sees the camera in her bag. He asks about her walk.
“Hi, Sara! How was your photo walk yesterday?” says Paul. “It was great! I walked for three hours and took a lot of pictures.” says Sara. “How many pictures did you take?” says Paul.
